evidence.excerpt: Specifically, across four multi-modal QA benchmarks, our refinements improve downstream accuracy by up to $1.7$\,pp over vanilla SFT (and $5.7$\,pp over an LLM-deletion baseline) while reducing per-sample inference messages by up to approximately $40\%$ and inference tokens by up to approximately $48\%$, translating to substantial savings in compute and serving cost.
